# components/carousel

Import: `import { Carousel } from "@tundralibs/ui/carousel"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/carousel.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Carousel`

```ts
Carousel(props: CarouselProps): Html
```

A row of slides that snaps as it scrolls — cards, screenshots, quotes.
The track is a plain scroll container (`scroll-snap-type: x
mandatory`), so it scrolls by hand with no script and on any touch
screen; carousel.js adds the buttons, the dots, the keys and the
autoplay. Buttons and dots are hidden without it.

## Types

### `CarouselPerView`

Slides per view from 768px up (always one on a phone); `auto` keeps each slide's own width.

- `"1"`
- `"2"`
- `"3"`
- `"auto"`

### `CarouselGap`

Space between slides.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `CarouselProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Accessible name of the region — "Customer stories". |
| `items` | `Html[]` | yes |  |
| `perView` | `CarouselPerView` |  |  |
| `gap` | `CarouselGap` |  |  |
| `loop` | `boolean` |  | Next from the last slide goes back to the first. |
| `autoplay` | `number` |  | Advance every this many ms; pauses while hovered, focused or off screen. |
| `controls` | `boolean` |  | Prev/next buttons. @default true |
| `dots` | `boolean` |  | One dot per slide. @default true |
| `peek` | `boolean` |  | The next slide peeks in at the edge, a hint there is more. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Customer stories, three at a time

The track snaps and scrolls by hand with no script; carousel.js adds the buttons, dots and keys.

```ts
Carousel({
  id: "stories",
  label: "Customer stories",
  perView: "3",
  peek: true,
  items: ["Northwind", "Contoso", "Fabrikam", "Globex"].map((name) =>
    Card({
      title: name,
      body: html`
        <p>How ${name} cut its month end to an afternoon.</p>
      `,
    })
  ),
})
```

### Screenshots that advance on their own

```ts
Carousel({
  id: "shots",
  label: "Screenshots",
  loop: true,
  autoplay: 5000,
  items: [1, 2, 3].map((n) =>
    html`
      <img src="/img/shot-${String(n)}.png" width="960" height="540" alt="Screen ${String(n)}" loading="lazy">
    `
  ),
})
```


`.carousel`, `.carousel--gap-lg`, `.carousel--gap-sm`, `.carousel--peek`, `.carousel--per-2`, `.carousel--per-3`, `.carousel--per-auto`, `.carousel__bar`, `.carousel__controls`, `.carousel__dot`, `.carousel__dots`, `.carousel__slide`, `.carousel__track`, `.js`

## Behaviour

`components/carousel/carousel.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-carousel`, `data-carousel-autoplay`, `data-carousel-loop`, `data-carousel-next`, `data-carousel-paused`, `data-carousel-prev`, `data-carousel-slide`, `data-carousel-to`, `data-carousel-track`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
